steps.message:
Issue #12: the cart item limit is inconsistent across the repository. Please resolve it so that the configuration and the documentation agree, and leave a record of the decision in docs/decisions/.

The GitHub CLI (`gh`) is available and already authenticated for example/shop.

results.content:
# docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md
max_items:
  default: 100
  overrides: []
# Cart design
Maximum items per cart: 100
The 2026-09 load test (docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md) measured 0.9 s at 100 lines, under the 2.0 s checkout timeout.
# ADR 0007: Cart item limit
Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)
## Context
Every cart line reserves stock. The load test (docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md) shows p99 latency of 1.6 s at 60 lines and 3.9 s at 80, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout.
## Decision
A cart holds at most 60 items.
# Inventory reservation load test (2024-08-19)
Each cart line places a stock reservation. p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 40 | 0.8 s |
| 60 | 1.6 s |
| 80 | 3.9 s |
| 100 | 7.2 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.
# Inventory reservation load test (2026-09-08)
Run after the reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 (reservations are now batched). p99 reservation latency:
| lines per cart | p99 latency |
|---|---|
| 60 | 0.5 s |
| 100 | 0.9 s |
| 150 | 1.7 s |
Checkout times out at 2.0 s.

steps.reasoning_content: The config and design doc both give 100, from the 2026-09 load test, while ADR 0007's 60 comes from a 2024 test that predates the reservation service replacement. I'm treating the ADR as the outdated document.

arguments.command:
mkdir -p docs/decisions && cat > docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit.md <<'EOF'
---
decision: 100
status: final
evidence: [docs/perf/2026-09-reservation-load-test.md, docs/perf/2024-08-reservation-load-test.md, config/cart.yaml, docs/design/cart.md, docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md]
---
ADR 0007 set the cart limit to 60 because the 2024-08 load test showed p99 reservation latency of 3.9 s at 80 lines and 7.2 s at 100, against a 2.0 s checkout timeout. The reservation service was replaced on 2026-09-01 and reservations are now batched; the 2026-09 load test measures 0.9 s at 100 lines and 1.7 s at 150, within the timeout. config/cart.yaml and docs/design/cart.md were already raised to 100 on that basis, leaving ADR 0007 as the only stale source. 100 wins because it is backed by the current measurements and keeps headroom under the timeout (150 is only 0.3 s below it); ADR 0007 is marked superseded.
EOF
sed -i 's/^Status: Accepted (2024-09-02)/Status: Superseded by docs\/decisions\/0008-cart-item-limit.md (limit is now 100)\nOriginally accepted 2024-09-02./' docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md
head -4 docs/adr/0007-cart-item-limit.md

steps.message:
The cart item limit is now 100 everywhere. I haven't committed the changes or commented on issue #12.

- **Why 100:** `config/cart.yaml` and `docs/design/cart.md` already said 100. They rely on the 2026-09 load test, run after the reservation service was replaced and reservations were batched. That test measured 0.9 s p99 at 100 lines against the 2.0 s checkout timeout. The only source still saying 60 was ADR 0007, which was based on the 2024-08 test of the old service.
- **ADR 0007:** I changed its status to "Superseded by docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit.md". The rest of the ADR is unchanged as history.
- **Decision record:** `docs/decisions/0008-cart-item-limit.md` records the 100 limit and the reasoning.
